en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large statue of a man in a cloak standing on an ornate pedestal in a city square. Behind the monument are multi‑storey historic buildings with classical facades, and in the foreground people are walking and sitting among trees and benches. Caption text appears at the bottom of the image, and the reverse side is blank with the typical divided back for address and message.
